sections.title: Before booking in Kelowna
sections.html:
Before gathering a group, ask whether the proposed address is within the service area and what the final total includes. Confirm the number of guests, individual appointment time, lighting requirements and cancellation terms. Do not assume that a quoted per-person amount means the analyst will travel for one person at that rate.

  • What is the total for a Kelowna visit, including any travel charges?
  • What minimum group size, space and lighting are required?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: If you are exploring alone, use a phone palette to identify the specific questions you would want to ask. If a friend also wants a consultation, compare your goals before booking together. After the session, each person should leave with their own useful combinations and references. Sharing the appointment can spread travel logistics, but it does not make the same colors work for everyone.
